The *Uttarāvimānavatthu* (Vv 15) is a verse text in the *Vimānavatthu* of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The core teaching of the text centers on the karmic results of moral discipline, illustrating that living a restrained life, maintaining the ethical precepts, and practicing generosity yield wholesome rewards in heavenly realms [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs six modern translations of the text across six languages [SuttaCentral].
